text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with platinum pale pink hair in long twin ponytails and soft layered fringe, sea green eyes, refined natural facial proportions and pale peach skin with subtle pores. Pink satin bow and floral hair ornaments, heart-shaped gold earrings, black leather collar with antique gold buckles over a high lace neckline. Pink and white floral dress with opaque bodice, fine lace ruffles and a large pink bow. Realistic modeled facial planes, subtle subsurface scattering and restrained specular highlights; avoid flat anime shading, oversized doll eyes, waxy skin or plastic doll appearance. Continue the floral pink-white dress into a knee-length bell-shaped lace skirt with opaque petticoat and large waist bow, bare legs with ivory ankle socks and pink Mary Jane flats. Slim healthy tall 173 cm proportions, not a doll body. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
